changelog:
* **fix: declare ContentDrawScope receiver on draw override** (44ef30a)
  - DrawModifierNode.draw is a member extension on ContentDrawScope and must be
    overridden with the explicit receiver, otherwise it overrides nothing
  - NoIndicationNode now mirrors the library's own override pattern
  TEST: not run — compile fix; build on Windows (gradlew.bat assembleDebug)
* **fix: replace null indication provider with no-op factory** (3d416aa)
  - LocalIndication is non-nullable in foundation 1.7.6, so provides null was a compile error
  - NoIndication (IndicationNodeFactory) draws nothing and is provided to LocalIndication
  - Clear and OK buttons stay ripple-free; chips, stepper and overscroll unchanged
  TEST: not run — compile fix; build on Windows (gradlew.bat assembleDebug)
* **fix: nuke all ripples in quantity sheet** (eb91bc2)
  - Preset chips, stepper buttons, Clear and OK buttons draw no ripple at all
  - Overscroll glow/stretch suppressed on the sheet scroll container
  - Selection highlight, semantics, haptics and pressScale are unchanged
  TEST: not run — visual-only change; build on Windows (gradlew.bat assembleDebug)
* **docs: reorder credits rows** (4f8d7b6)
